items.title: Release notes, nicely formatted
items.text: The update window now shows the release notes with headings and lists instead of plain text.

items.title: A proper “What’s new” window
items.text: After an update, this window lists the new features of every version you skipped – in your language.

items.title: Wider settings search
items.text: The search in the settings is wider and its suggestions are no longer cut off.

items.title: Instant restart
items.text: Start OpenCue right after closing it: it now waits until the old one has finished closing instead of saying it is already running.

items.title: Chat & Notes panel
items.text: Chat between the console, iPads and phones – with “is typing” – plus notes and checklists in Markdown, saved on the server.

items.title: Fixes
items.text: Long sub-menus scroll instead of being cut off, and password fields show dots again.

items.title: A new DMX core
items.text: Output, effects and cue fades run in their own process – a steady 40 frames per second even under heavy load.

items.title: DMX input
items.text: Receive Art-Net and sACN from another desk, forward and merge it, or use channels as triggers.

items.title: Remote control that can do everything
items.text: A tablet has the same rights as the console, including all settings.

items.title: Control from outside
items.text: MIDI, OSC, a REST API, custom keyboard shortcuts, a scheduler and offline voice control.

items.title: Timeline and timecode
items.text: A timeline editor with waveforms, LTC in and out, MIDI timecode.

items.title: Your own fixtures
items.text: A fixture editor, GDTF Share preview and CSV / Excel patch import.

items.title: Safe shows
items.text: Background backups with crash recovery, global undo and a show lock.

items.title: Six languages
items.text: German, English, French, Dutch, Italian and Spanish – including the guides.
